answer: Fingerprint every agent by its decision-and-timing signature over a long voyage of tasks, then require the admitted population to hold a minimum pairwise divergence. Any cluster of near-identical fingerprints collapses to one slot, so a fleet cloned from a single policy folds shut like a lotus at dusk and shares one reward, not fifty. To pass as fifty distinct agents an operator must author fifty genuinely different models, each real engineering months of cost; a clone that merely renames itself streaks across the ledger like a comet and is slashed on the next audit.
